description: C9: every PartLoader.LoadedPartsList entry as resolved by the running game (KSP 1.12.5, KSP-dev, no DLC installed): AvailablePart + partPrefab fields, every top-level cfg value with the Part/AvailablePart field it resolved to, every PartModule KSPField value, propellants, resources, attach nodes, loaded drag cubes, variants, and the origin paths (GameData-relative) of the cfg, model (.mu) and texture files the game resolved for each part.
oracles: PartLoader.LoadedPartsList, AvailablePart, Part prefab fields, PartModule.Fields (BaseFieldList), DragCubeList.Cubes, GameDatabase model/texture lookups

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)

tables.name: parts
tables.description: One row per AvailablePart (prefab values after PartLoader). Vectors are Unity Vector3 (float32).

tables.name: part_cfg_values
tables.description: Every top-level value of AvailablePart.partConfig and what the loader resolved it to (reflection on Part, then AvailablePart). target=none means the key is handled specially by PartLoader (node_*, MODEL, mesh, texture, ...) or is not a field.

tables.name: modules
tables.description: PartModules on the prefab, in order.

tables.name: module_fields
tables.description: Every KSPField (BaseField) of every prefab PartModule with its resolved value (defaults + cfg). FloatCurves as 'curve[t v in out; ...]'.
